reason: I already have a designer I trust, and a freelancer or my nephew handles the logos. The carousel is nice to look at, but it does not tell me why a studio that is not local would understand my business better than the people I already work with.
objection: Is a remote studio worth it compared to someone local? I cannot tell from a feed post whether they would know my market or answer my calls.
would_change_my_mind: A clear example of a business like mine, close to my market, that they redesigned and that did better afterwards, plus a price I can see before I commit time to a call.
